No explanation, no markdown, no preamble.\n\nGenerate 4 distinct academic search queries for a literature survey on: "' + $('Initialise State').first().json.topic + '". parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.first().json;
return (data.queries || []).map(query => ({ json: { query, topic: data.topic, executionId: data.executionId, maxPapers: data.maxPapers, options: data.options } }));

parameters.text:
={{ 'You are an academic paper quality assessor. Always respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no explanation, no preamble.

Research topic: ' + $('Initialise State').first().json.topic + '

Paper to evaluate:
Title: ' + ($json.title || '') + '
Year: ' + ($json.year || 'unknown') + '
Venue: ' + ($json.venue || 'unknown') + '
Citation count: ' + ($json.citationCount || 0) + '
Abstract: ' + ($json.abstract || '').substring(0, 600) + '

Return ONLY a JSON object with these exact keys:
- quality_score: number 0-10 (methodology, rigor)
- relevance_score: number 0-10 (relevance to topic)
- credibility_score: number 0-10 (venue reputation, citation count, recency)
- keep: boolean
- primary_theme: short string
- reason: one sentence' }}

={{ 'You are an expert academic writer producing structured literature surveys. Always respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown fences, no preamble, no text outside the JSON object.

Research topic: "' + $json.topic + '"
Identified themes: ' + ($json.themes || []).join(', ') + '

Validated papers (' + $json.paperCount + ' total):

' + $json.paperList + '

Write a comprehensive academic literature survey synthesising all listed papers. Return ONLY this JSON:
{
  "introduction": "<2-3 paragraphs: importance, scope, section overview>",
  "themes": [{ "title": "<theme>", "content": "<2-3 paragraphs citing papers as [1], [2] etc>", "paperRefs": [<paper numbers>] }],
  "methodologies": "<1-2 paragraphs comparing research methods>",
  "keyFindings": "<1-2 paragraphs on significant findings>",
  "limitations": "<1 paragraph on gaps and limitations>",
  "researchGaps": "<1 paragraph on future directions>",
  "conclusion": "<1-2 paragraph conclusion>"
}' }}
